content: उत्सह् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To be able, have power or energy; (expressed by ‘can’); dare, venture (with <ab>inf.</ab>); तवानुवृत्तिं न च कर्तुमुत्सहे <ls>Ku. 5. 65</ls>; <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; <ls>Mu. 4. 14</ls>; <ls>Śi. 14. 83</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 54</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">5. 59</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">14. 89</ls>, sometimes with <ab>acc.</ab> and <ab>dat.</ab> also; <ls>Pt. 1</ls>. .²2 To attempt, be prompted or incited; <ls>Ki. 1. 36</ls>; to cheer up, not to sink or give way; अज्ञवन्नोत्सहेथास्त्वम् <ls>Bk. 19. 16</ls>. .²3 To feel at ease, enjoy pleasure; क्षणमप्युत्सहते न मां विना <ls>Ku. 4. 36</ls>. .²4 To go forward, march on; <ls>K. 249</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To encourage, excite, instigate, incite; वरुणोत्साहितेन वेधसा <ls>K. 22</ls>; <ls>Bk. 9. 69</ls>.
